content:
iPhone 18 Pro is set to be unveiled next week, with a reliable Weibo leaker publishing a new post listing three expected new colours for its first appearance.

iPhone 18 Pro may come in three brand-new colours, carrying over none of last year's options.

Apple will reveal all the details of its new flagship iPhone models at its September event next week.

The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max will launch alongside the iPhone Ultra, and market rumours have already leaked plenty of expected details.

Colour options are often one of the last details Apple finalises. However, reports this year broadly point to the flagship line replacing Cosmic Orange with a deep cherry / wine red, alongside a new silver and sky blue.

Multiple reports remain divided on whether Apple will offer a black / space grey version this year.

But the latest post from Weibo leaker Fixed Focus Digital points to a slightly different colour lineup. He predicts:

  • Deep cherry red / wine red
  • Sky blue
  • Black

The leaker says silver is "very likely" not happening, adding in a follow-up post that he has seen no evidence pointing to that version. If this lineup holds true, Apple would be replacing the entire iPhone 17 Pro colour palette with brand-new options.

Sky blue has previously appeared on both the iPhone Air and the MacBook Air — both times as a very pale shade of blue that reads closer to silver under everyday lighting. So Apple may well be using sky blue to appeal to buyers who prefer silver.

Many users were disappointed that last year's iPhone 17 Pro offered no black or space grey option. So hopes are high that this latest leak is accurate, bringing black back to the iPhone 18 Pro.

Out of all these new iPhone 18 Pro colours above, which one would you pick? Let us know in the comments.
